title: Exam-Style Papers
description: Train for the end-of-basic-education national exam on one text per paper, across the six modules of the book. Reading: the main idea, scanning and justifying with the text, reference words, words in context, inference. Language in context: the time marker chooses the tense, the function chooses the pattern, linkers of cause, result and contrast. Writing: a clear, unified paragraph.
